# criblio_search_dataset_acl (Data Source)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_dataset_acl" "example" {
  dataset_id = "application_logs"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) ID of the existing Search dataset in default_search. Changing it replaces the ACL resource.

### Read-Only

- `teams` (Map of String) Explicit team shares, mapping team IDs to DatasetRead or DatasetMaintain. Omit to leave team shares unmanaged; an empty map revokes all supported explicit team shares.
- `users` (Map of String) Explicit user and API-credential shares, mapping Cloud member IDs (not emails) or <client-id>@clients to DatasetRead or DatasetMaintain. Find member IDs in GET /products/search/users by matching email to id. Omit to leave user shares unmanaged; an empty map revokes all supported explicit user shares.
